title: Sky ship with glowing sails snags a London chimney with its anchor

tellings.quote: I read a story of a a sailing ship with glowing sails flying over London and an anchor comes out and snags a chimney and breaks the top off of a chimney.

plain: Sometime in the early 1800s, a sailing ship with glowing sails is said to have flown over London, dropped an anchor that caught on a chimney, and broken the top off it. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he draws UFOs to him, tells Michels he read this story, without saying where. To him it is an old account of a flying craft seen long before anyone talked about UFOs.
